description: The Water Quality Portal (WQP) is a cooperative service that integrates publicly available discrete water quality data from the US Geological Survey (NWIS), the Environmental Protection Agency (WQX) and over 400 state, federal, tribal and local agencies, and describes itself as the premier source of discrete water quality data in the United States and beyond. Coverage: mainly the United States, from the contributing agencies' monitoring sites. Users query by location (country, state, county, point and radius, site type), by data source, date range, sample media and characteristic group, and choose a data type and file format; an advanced download offers more options. Format and access: web query forms and download services returning site, sample and result data; free. Licence: not read on the page opened. Caveats: data come from many agencies with different methods and quality control, so results need harmonisation; only the query page was read. Simulation uses: source water and receiving water quality for drinking water and wastewater system planning and for assessing contamination events after floods or spills. Related records: the USGS Water Data APIs (data-usgs-water-data-apis) provide streamflow and groundwater data from the same agency.
